LanguageData.Gun_M14_RWP.description: The M14 is a robust battle rifle, known for its high durability and powerful 7.62mm rounds. With a long range and moderate firing rate, it excels at mid to long-range engagements, offering precise shots with significant stopping power. Its design makes it slightly heavier but compensates with accuracy and lethal force.
